_readme: Main Library entrance kiosk, Cut 1 (Walkable). Every fact is a bare [[label]] placeholder, so it can only render as a visible [PLACEHOLDER: …] tag, except the nearest staffed desk: the lending desk, right behind the patron across the hallway (Jungu, on site, 2026-10-15; logged in _FROM-BUILD as a catalog candidate). No sample values in this cut, not even behind a demo flag (entrance-kiosk/BUILD-entrance-kiosk.md). The directory names are a draft starting list for desk staff to correct. In Cut 2 this file is replaced by a generated sync from the vault's catalog/main-library/.
